title: Are there any detailed Instruction for rayhunter?
body:
Are there any instruction for rayhunter?  The website was vague and just said plug it and and install, but not much more.  When do I plug it in?  Does it need to be turned on or off when I plug it in?  What files do I run, and how?  I downloaded the Arm Apple one for my M4 Mini, but I don't know what to do with the files in it as there are no instruction, and none of the files have an extension, so I'm not just going to start double clicking files, if that even works.  Maybe I need to run some command through the terminal.  Again, I don't know as there are no instructions.
